steps.name: environment - Install Swift toolchain and runtime libs (secure, idempotent)
steps.description: Install a pinned Swift toolchain for Ubuntu 24.04, required runtime libraries and small utilities (jq). Use releases.json to find tarball filename (with resilient filename matching and platform fallbacks), verify SHA256, extract into a temp dir then atomically move into /usr/share/swift-<ver>, create stable symlink /usr/share/swift, persist PATH via /etc/profile.d, and create /usr/local/bin/swift shim for non-login shells. Skip install when an existing swift on PATH satisfies >= required semver (dpkg --compare-versions). This step is idempotent and non-interactive.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/user-dashboard-calculator-10101-10110/ios_frontend"
SWIFT_VER_STR="5.9.7"
SWIFT_BASE_DIR="/usr/share"
SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR="${SWIFT_BASE_DIR}/swift-${SWIFT_VER_STR}"
SWIFT_SYMLINK="${SWIFT_BASE_DIR}/swift"
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$TMPDIR"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
# Ensure required packages including jq
sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y -qq ca-certificates curl wget tar sqlite3 libsqlite3-dev cmake pkg-config libatomic1 libicu-dev libssl-dev libcurl4 jq >/dev/null
# Disk space preflight (require at least 200MB free in /usr)
FREE_KB=$(df --output=avail /usr | tail -n1 || echo 0)
if [ "$FREE_KB" -lt 200000 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: insufficient disk space in /usr (need ~200MB)" >&2
  exit 10
fi
# If swift exists and meets >= required version, skip install
if command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  EXIST_VER_RAW=$(swift --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
  if echo "$EXIST_VER_RAW" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    EXIST_VER=$(echo "$EXIST_VER_RAW" | grep -Eo '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -n1)
    if dpkg --compare-versions "$EXIST_VER" ge "$SWIFT_VER_STR"; then
      echo "INFO: existing swift $EXIST_VER satisfies >= $SWIFT_VER_STR" >&2
      # ensure shim exists for non-login shells
      if [ ! -x /usr/local/bin/swift ]; then
        sudo bash -c 'cat >/usr/local/bin/swift <<"SH"\n#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec /usr/share/swift/usr/bin/swift "$@"\nSH'
        sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/swift
      fi
      exit 0
    fi
  fi
fi
# Fetch releases.json
METADATA_URL="https://download.swift.org/releases.json"
RETRY_ARGS=(--retry 3 --retry-delay 5 --fail --silent --show-error)
curl "${RETRY_ARGS[@]}" -o releases.json "$METADATA_URL"
# Try to locate tarball by filename matching version and platform; allow platform fallbacks
TARBALL_NAME=$(jq -r --arg v "$SWIFT_VER_STR" '.releases[] | select(.version==$v) | .files[]?.filename' releases.json 2>/dev/null | grep -E "${SWIFT_VER_STR}.*(ubuntu24.04|ubuntu22.04|ubuntu20.04|linux).*\.tar\.gz" | head -n1 || true)
if [ -z "$TARBALL_NAME" ]; then
  # fallback pattern
  TARBALL_NAME="swift-${SWIFT_VER_STR}-RELEASE-ubuntu24.04.tar.gz"
fi
SWIFT_URL="https://download.swift.org/${TARBALL_NAME}"
# Obtain checksum if available (try .checksum or .sha256)
SWIFT_SHA256=$(jq -r --arg f "$TARBALL_NAME" '.releases[]?.files[]? | select(.filename==$f) | .checksum // .sha256 // empty' releases.json 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$SWIFT_SHA256" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: could not determine SHA256 for $TARBALL_NAME from releases.json" >&2
  rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
  exit 2
fi
ARCHIVE="$TMPDIR/$TARBALL_NAME"
curl "${RETRY_ARGS[@]}" -o "$ARCHIVE" "$SWIFT_URL" || { echo "ERROR: download failed $SWIFT_URL" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 3; }
# Verify checksum
echo "${SWIFT_SHA256}  ${ARCHIVE}" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: checksum mismatch for $ARCHIVE" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 4; }
# Extract into temp and then move atomically
EXTRACT_DIR="$TMPDIR/swift-extract"
mkdir -p "$EXTRACT_DIR"
tar -xzf "$ARCHIVE" -C "$EXTRACT_DIR" || { echo "ERROR: tar extraction failed" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 5; }
# Move to versioned dir atomically
sudo rm -rf "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR" || true
sudo mv "$EXTRACT_DIR" "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR"
# Ensure layout: some archives include top-level subdir; normalize to /usr/share/swift-<ver>/usr/bin
if [ -d "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR/usr/bin" ]; then
  true
else
  # if binary lives directly under install, wrap it
  if [ -d "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR/bin" ]; then
    sudo mkdir -p "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR/usr" && sudo mv "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR/bin" "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR/usr/bin" || true
  fi
fi
sudo chown -R root:root "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR"
# Update symlink atomically
sudo ln -sfn "$SWIFT_INSTALL_DIR" "$SWIFT_SYMLINK"
# Persist PATH via /etc/profile.d
PROFILE_FILE="/etc/profile.d/swift.sh"
sudo bash -c "cat > ${PROFILE_FILE}" <<'EOF'
# Swift toolchain
if [ -d /usr/share/swift/usr/bin ]; then
  export PATH=/usr/share/swift/usr/bin:$PATH
fi
EOF
sudo chmod +x ${PROFILE_FILE}
# Create a shim so non-login shells can find swift
sudo bash -c 'cat >/usr/local/bin/swift <<"SH"\n#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec /usr/share/swift/usr/bin/swift "$@"\nSH'
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/swift
# Ensure current shell can use swift
export PATH=/usr/share/swift/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH
if ! command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: swift not on PATH after install" >&2
  rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
  exit 6
fi
swift --version >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: swift --version failed" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 7; }
swiftc --version >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: swiftc --version failed" >&2; rm -rf "$TMPDIR"; exit 8; }
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"
exit 0

steps.name: scaffolding - Create Swift package, Calculator library and demo executable
steps.description: Create a minimal Swift Package in the workspace with a Calculator library, a demo executable used by validation, and an XCTest unit test. Use tools-version 5.9 matching the pinned toolchain. Generate concise build and start helper scripts. The demo uses portable signal handling so SIGTERM causes graceful shutdown.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/user-dashboard-calculator-10101-10110/ios_frontend"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
if [ ! -f "$WORKSPACE/Package.swift" ]; then
  cat > "$WORKSPACE/Package.swift" <<'PW'
// swift-tools-version:5.9
import PackageDescription
let package = Package(
  name: "CalculatorPackage",
  products: [
    .library(name: "Calculator", targets: ["Calculator"]),
    .executable(name: "demo", targets: ["Demo"]),
  ],
  targets: [
    .target(name: "Calculator", path: "Sources/Calculator"),
    .executableTarget(name: "Demo", path: "Sources/Demo"),
    .testTarget(name: "CalculatorTests", dependencies: ["Calculator"], path: "Tests/CalculatorTests"),
  ]
)
PW
fi
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/Sources/Calculator" "$WORKSPACE/Sources/Demo" "$WORKSPACE/Tests/CalculatorTests"
cat > "$WORKSPACE/Sources/Calculator/Calculator.swift" <<'CS'
public struct Calculator {
  public init() {}
  public func add(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Int { a + b }
}
CS
# Demo executable: simple runloop, portable signal handling
cat > "$WORKSPACE/Sources/Demo/main.swift" <<'DM'
import Foundation
import Dispatch
print("demo starting")
fflush(stdout)
let sem = DispatchSemaphore(value: 0)
signal(SIGTERM) { _ in
  print("demo shutting down")
  fflush(stdout)
  sem.signal()
}
signal(SIGINT) { _ in
  print("demo interrupt")
  fflush(stdout)
  sem.signal()
}
_ = sem.wait(timeout: .distantFuture)
DM
cat > "$WORKSPACE/Tests/CalculatorTests/CalculatorTests.swift" <<'TS'
import XCTest
@testable import Calculator
final class CalculatorTests: XCTestCase {
  func testAdd() {
    XCTAssertEqual(Calculator().add(2,3), 5)
  }
}
TS
# helper scripts
cat > "$WORKSPACE/build.sh" <<'BS'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "${WORKSPACE}"
swift build -c debug
BS
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/build.sh"
cat > "$WORKSPACE/start.sh" <<'SS'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "${WORKSPACE}"
BIN_DIR=$(swift build --show-bin-path 2>/dev/null || echo ".build/debug")
exec "${BIN_DIR}/demo"
SS
chmod +x "$WORKSPACE/start.sh"

Set XCTEST_DISABLE_CONCURRENCY=1 to force single-threaded XCTest execution to avoid SQLite/file races, export a unique test DB path, and run swift test. Fail fast on test failures.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/user-dashboard-calculator-10101-10110/ios_frontend"
# Persist minimal env for future shells
sudo bash -c 'cat > /etc/profile.d/ios_frontend_env.sh <<"EOF"
# Mock API endpoints for ios_frontend tests
export IOS_FRONTEND_API_URL="https://mock-api.local"
export IOS_FRONTEND_AUTH_TOKEN="test-token"
EOF'
sudo chmod +x /etc/profile.d/ios_frontend_env.sh
# Export into current shell for immediate effect
export IOS_FRONTEND_API_URL="https://mock-api.local"
export IOS_FRONTEND_AUTH_TOKEN="test-token"
export XCTEST_DISABLE_CONCURRENCY=1
export IOS_FRONTEND_TEST_DB="/tmp/ios_frontend_test_$(date +%s).db"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Run tests
swift test || { echo "ERROR: swift test failed" >&2; exit 6; }
echo "OK: tests passed"

steps.name: validation - Build, run built demo binary, probe, stop and report evidence
steps.description: Build the package, locate the built demo binary using 'swift build --show-bin-path', execute the built binary directly to get the real PID, capture logs, probe process health, send SIGTERM and wait for clean exit (with fallback to SIGKILL), and print log excerpt as evidence. Ensure environment variables required by the app/tests are exported before launch.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/user-dashboard-calculator-10101-10110/ios_frontend"
# Ensure env vars available to child process
export IOS_FRONTEND_API_URL="https://mock-api.local"
export IOS_FRONTEND_AUTH_TOKEN="test-token"
export IOS_FRONTEND_TEST_DB="/tmp/ios_frontend_test_$(date +%s).db"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Build to ensure binary exists
swift build -c debug || { echo "ERROR: build failed" >&2; exit 2; }
BIN_DIR=$(swift build --show-bin-path 2>/dev/null || echo ".build/debug")
DEMO_BIN="$BIN_DIR/demo"
if [ ! -x "$DEMO_BIN" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: demo binary not found at $DEMO_BIN" >&2
  exit 3
fi
OUTDIR=$(mktemp -d)
LOGFILE="$OUTDIR/demo.log"
# Start demo binary directly
"$DEMO_BIN" >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
DEMO_PID=$!
sleep 1
if ! kill -0 "$DEMO_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: demo did not start; log:" >&2
  tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" >&2 || true
  rm -rf "$OUTDIR"
  exit 4
fi
echo "INFO: demo started pid=$DEMO_PID"
head -n 20 "$LOGFILE" || true
sleep 1
# Stop demo cleanly
kill -TERM "$DEMO_PID" || true
# wait up to 10s
WAIT=0
while kill -0 "$DEMO_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $WAIT -lt 10 ]; do
  sleep 1; WAIT=$((WAIT+1))
done
if kill -0 "$DEMO_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "WARN: demo did not exit after SIGTERM, sending SIGKILL" >&2
  kill -KILL "$DEMO_PID" || true
fi
echo "--- demo.log (last 50 lines) ---"
tail -n 50 "$LOGFILE" || true
echo "--- process status ---"
if ps -p "$DEMO_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: demo still running" >&2
  rm -rf "$OUTDIR"
  exit 6
else
  echo "OK: demo stopped"
fi
rm -rf "$OUTDIR"
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ ${1:-} = "" ]; then
  echo "USAGE: stop <outdir>" >&2
  exit 2
fi
OUTDIR="$1"
PIDFILE="$OUTDIR/demo.pid"
LOGFILE="$OUTDIR/demo.log"
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: pidfile not found in $OUTDIR" >&2
  exit 3
fi
DEMO_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
# Send SIGTERM
kill -TERM "$DEMO_PID" || true
# wait up to 10s
WAIT=0
while kill -0 "$DEMO_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $WAIT -lt 10 ]; do
  sleep 1; WAIT=$((WAIT+1))
done
if kill -0 "$DEMO_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "WARN: demo did not exit after SIGTERM, sending SIGKILL" >&2
  kill -KILL "$DEMO_PID" || true
fi
# Report log excerpt and process status
echo "--- demo.log (last 50 lines) ---"
tail -n 50 "$LOGFILE" || true
if ps -p "$DEMO_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: demo still running" >&2
  exit 6
else
  echo "OK: demo stopped"
fi
# Cleanup
rm -rf "$OUTDIR"

change_logs.message: Refined initial plan to address analyst feedback: env-01 updated for reproducible, idempotent Swift install (pinned version, exact URL, SHA256 verification, extract to /usr/share/swift-<version> and symlink), added version checks to skip re-install when compatible Swift exists; scaffold-02 updated to create an explicit Package.swift declaring 'Calculator' library and 'demo' executable, removed naive import of SQLite3 from library and kept Calculator logic pure for tests; test-04 now exports env vars into current shell before running swift test and uses a unique temp DB path if needed; deps-03 (renamed to build-03) now validates swift package resolve/build results; validation-05 enhanced to start the demo binary with swift run in background, verify it's running, capture logs, then terminate it cleanly and report evidence. Also fixed script_name consistency and added clearer error messages and idempotency for file operations. These changes address brittle download logic, incorrect XCTest scaffolding, missing start/stop validation, env persistence/runtime usage, and idempotency/security concerns.

Refinements made to address analyst feedback: env-01 modified to programmatically fetch Swift release metadata from download.swift.org to obtain exact tarball URL and SHA256 and to verify checksum (addresses missing checksum and URL pattern issues). env-01 now installs Swift runtime dependencies (libatomic1, libicu-dev, libssl-dev, libcurl4, ca-certificates) and uses tar --strip-components=1 to extract predictably; added curl retries and disk-space preflight check. Version detection enhanced to parse semantic version from 'swift --version' and accept >= required version. Extraction/move logic replaced with deterministic tar extraction. scaffold-02 updated Package.swift header to // swift-tools-version:5.9 to align with Swift 5.9.x. test-04 updated to export XCTEST_DISABLE_CONCURRENCY=1 before running swift test and documents /etc/profile.d behavior; it persists env to /etc/profile.d as before. validation-05 updated to run the built binary directly by resolving swift build --show-bin-path and executing the .build binary to ensure deterministic PID handling and reliable shutdown. Minor improvements: added explicit verification checks after install (swift --version & swiftc --version), added limited curl retries, and handled the case when /usr/share/swift exists as a non-symlink. Steps preserved from original plan; scripts shortened where possible while satisfying requirements.

Refined env-01, scaffold-02, build-03, test-04, and validation-05 to address analyst feedback: added jq install and dependency; replaced brittle jq filters with resilient filename-based selection and platform fallbacks; used dpkg --compare-versions to correctly accept existing swift >= required version; extract toolchain into temp dir then move atomically to versioned path; add /usr/local/bin shim and /etc/profile.d for non-login shell availability; added disk-space preflight and clearer error messages; made demo signal handling portable by removing SIG_IGN; removed '|| true' from swift package resolve to fail fast; ensured environment variables are exported into child processes before running tests/validation; updated top-level dependencies to include jq. These changes fix critical parsing and version-check bugs, improve idempotency and reliability, and ensure CI/non-login shells find swift.
